mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% consistently compresses real equity valuations through higher real discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive months indicates a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two months, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p>0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profit margins and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.0% and remains above that level for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for two months, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs per month indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) over the last two quarters signals a severe demand shock that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 decline in two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline for two quarters, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p>0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0% and the federal funds rate remains unchanged for three consecutive months, it indicates a persistent inflationary environment without accommodative policy, which depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with no rate cuts
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition, or the interaction term between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS has a non-significant coefficient (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
